scientific_objective: Evaluate whether rectangular visual erasure (CoarseDropout) improves detection robustness on dense, overlapping waste scenes by forcing the network to recognize objects from partial visual cues, while being explicit that synthetic rectangular erasure does not reproduce actual physical waste-on-waste occlusion.

scientific_framing_and_limitations.erasure_vs_physical_occlusion: Rectangular patch dropout deletes pixel information using neutral fill (114, 114, 114). It does NOT synthesize physical waste-on-waste overlap, texture interpenetration, shadow boundaries, or 3D depth layering. It tests whether partial-feature representation learning aids the observed overlap-stratum metric despite not generating realistic overlapping objects.
scientific_framing_and_limitations.no_guarantee_of_improvement: Partial erasure is an inductive bias test. If the detector relies primarily on global contours, erasure could degrade precision or isolated recall. Predeclared criteria strictly govern whether the intervention is accepted or rejected.

native_cutmix_limitation.mechanism: ioa1.sum(axis=1) <= 0 rejects any candidate patch touching an existing box, causing a 99% skip rate in waste scenes and strictly background-only placement. Native CutMix is structurally incapable of testing partial occlusion on primary objects.

albumentations_integration.bbox_preservation: Verified mathematically: bboxes are preserved with 100% coordinate fidelity (XYXY / YOLO normalized). Zero box truncation or deletion occurs under CoarseDropout.

primary_intervention.justification: Calibrated via empirical preflight on 100 training images (239 boxes). Provides meaningful partial erasure (15%-75% box area) on 10.0% of objects, while resulting in exactly 0.00% severe occlusion (>75%) and 0.00% object obliteration (>90%), preventing false-negative label noise.

baseline_augmentation_preservation.e002_albumentations_state: Zero Albumentations transforms were active during E002 (package was not installed; self.transform was None).
baseline_augmentation_preservation.e004_isolation_rule: Custom augmentations list is passed explicitly as [A.CoarseDropout(...)], replacing Ultralytics defaults and guaranteeing that Blur(p=0.01), MedianBlur(p=0.01), ToGray(p=0.01), and CLAHE(p=0.01) remain INACTIVE (p=0.0).

augmentation_schedule.selected_schedule: Active throughout all 100 epochs at defined probability p=0.5
augmentation_schedule.close_mosaic_interaction: Native close_mosaic=10 (ultralytics/data/dataset.py:384-394) resets hyp.mosaic=0.0, hyp.mixup=0.0, hyp.cutmix=0.0, and hyp.copy_paste=0.0 for epochs 91-100, while leaving hyp.augmentations (CoarseDropout) active throughout all 100 epochs.
augmentation_schedule.verification_mechanism: Dataset transforms inspected in representative epochs to confirm Mosaic closure and CoarseDropout persistence.

criterion_1_overlap_recall.name: Overlap Stratum Recall
criterion_1_overlap_recall.success_rule: Reduce overlap misses by at least 3 (<= 13 misses)
criterion_1_overlap_recall.evaluation_protocol: Greedy 1-to-1 matching at operational conf=0.25, NMS IoU=0.60, match IoU=0.50 on validation split
